meta.title: GEO aviation link geometry — course & presentation reference
meta.purpose: Slides, oral explanations, and diagram copy for PVG–CDG IFC / GEO elevation teaching
relatedAppFeatures: View 1 map: route coloured by best-GEO elevation tier
Analysis panel: altitude/speed profile + interactive elevation side-view

glossary.definition: Angle at the aircraft between the local horizontal plane and the line of sight to the GEO satellite.
glossary.note: Computed in-app with Re=6378.137 km, Rgeo=42164 km (same as 0.1513 ratio in textbooks).

glossary.definition: Point on Earth's equator directly below a GEO satellite (longitude = orbital slot).
glossary.note: GEO satellites appear fixed over one longitude; latitude = 0°.

glossary.definition: Satellite Access Station — ground earth station that connects the satellite feeder link to terrestrial IP networks.
Transparent GEO payload: uplink is frequency-shifted and amplified, not packet-processed onboard.
glossary.note: Inmarsat GX I-5 payload is bent-pipe Ka-band.

glossary.definition: Air traffic control voice/surveillance (VHF, ADS-B, CPDLC). Separate from Ku/Ka passenger broadband.
glossary.warning: Do not draw ATC as part of the GEO IFC chain in slides.

elevationThresholds.sourceNote: Matches app tier colours in src/app.js geoElevationTier()
elevationThresholds.operationalFloorRationale: Ka-band aviation IFC: rain fade, antenna scan limits, and regulatory/engineering practice often treat ~10° as practical service floor.

passengerBroadband: Aircraft Ka-band terminal (e.g. Honeywell JetWave class)
Over-the-air user link: Aircraft ↔ GEO (Inmarsat-5 / GX)
Feeder link: GEO ↔ Satellite Access Station (SAS)
atcSeparate: Pilot ↔ ATC: primarily VHF voice, ADS-B, CPDLC
Safety services may use L-band (e.g. SwiftBroadband Safety) — parallel to Ka IFC, not the same chain

slideDeckOutline.title: Why elevation matters on long-haul routes
bullets: GEO sits ~35,786 km above the equator — aircraft sees it at an elevation angle θ
Lower θ → longer slant path → more atmosphere & rain fade (critical for Ka)
Along PVG–CDG, latitude and longitude change which GEO slot is best

slideDeckOutline.title: Side-view geometry (meridian slice)
bullets: Earth arc, aircraft at cruise (~12 km), GEO above equator slot
Draw θ at aircraft between horizontal and line-of-sight
Label: NOT to scale (GEO distance compressed in teaching diagrams)
slideDeckOutline.diagramHint: Use app Analysis panel screenshot or redraw from geo-link-presentation.md ASCII

slideDeckOutline.title: End-to-end GX Aviation chain (bent-pipe)
bullets: Satellite does not terminate IP; it relays RF
ATC tower is a separate slide / dashed box — not in this chain

slideDeckOutline.title: PVG–CDG study: what the app shows
bullets: Representative ADS-B track (32 samples) — one published ATS-style path
Map colours = best route-serving GX elevation tier
Table = per-satellite % of track with θ ≥ 10°
Live aircraft layer = OpenSky snapshot (optional, separate from representative track)

references.title: Earth station elevation angle (GEO)
references.note: el = atan((cos(Δλ)cos(φ) − Re/Rgeo) / sqrt(1 − cos²(Δλ)cos²(φ))); Re/Rgeo ≈ 0.1513
